title: The Framed Beltrami-Vekua Normal Form and its Pseudo-Analytic Mass
summary: We normalize a first-order real planar elliptic system, by pointwise algebra, to a framed Beltrami-Vekua equation $Φ(w_{\bar z} - μw_z) + Ψ(\overline{w_z} - μ\,\overline{w_{\bar z}}) + \mathfrak{a} w + \mathfrak{b} \bar w = \mathfrak{f}$, with $|μ| |Ψ|$, and compute the closed transformation laws of its data under the recombination of unknowns $w \mapsto \varphi w + ψ\bar w$ and under orientation-preserving $C^1$ changes of variables. The 2-form $Θ= \frac{\bigl|\,Φ\,\mathfrak{b} - Ψ\,\mathfrak{a} - (Φ\, LΨ- Ψ\, LΦ)\,\bigr|^2}{\bigl(|Φ|^2 - |Ψ|^2\bigr)^2\,\bigl(1 - |μ|^2\bigr)}\; dx\, dy$,…
